summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem has exploded past 15,000 listed servers across registries by 2026, becoming the de facto standard for connecting AI agents to tools, data, and services. It matters because MCP gives LLM-based agents a uniform, secure way to call external capabilities—reading repos, driving browsers, querying databases—without bespoke integrations for each client. The durable winners are vendor-maintained, least-privilege servers used daily, not simply the ones with the most GitHub stars.
ecosystem_note: Aggregators (like Composio and Smithery) are registries/marketplaces that discover and host many servers; gateways (like agentgateway and Cloudflare MCP) are proxies that add auth, routing, and governance in front of servers; individual servers (like Playwright MCP or GitHub MCP) are the single-purpose connectors that actually expose a specific tool or service.

tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.connects_to: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, and Actions; sign-in replaces token-in-config auth
tools.pricing_paid: Included with GitHub plans; usage follows GitHub account tier
strengths: Vendor-maintained and least-privilege by default
Deep coverage of repos, issues, PRs, and Actions
OAuth sign-in instead of tokens in config files
tools.best_for: Automating code, repository, and pull-request workflows from AI agents

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.connects_to: Local browser automation—navigating, clicking, and scraping pages from Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and ~a dozen other clients
strengths: One-command install via npx @playwright/mcp@latest
Works across a huge range of MCP clients
Reliable local-only browser control
tools.best_for: Browser automation and end-to-end testing on your own machine

tools.name: Context7 MCP
tools.connects_to: Up-to-date library and framework documentation injected directly into coding agents
tools.pricing_paid: Free tier with paid higher-usage plans via Upstash
strengths: Keeps agents current with real documentation
Reduces hallucinated APIs in generated code
Widely cited as a daily developer favorite
tools.best_for: Giving coding assistants accurate, version-correct documentation context

tools.name: Composio
tools.connects_to: Hundreds of apps (GitHub, Slack, Gmail, Notion, etc.) with managed OAuth and a unified gateway
tools.pricing_paid: Usage-based paid tiers for managed auth and higher volume
strengths: Managed OAuth removes per-server token handling
Large catalog of pre-built integrations
Lowers maintenance burden with a managed gateway
tools.best_for: Teams wanting one managed layer for many authenticated integrations

tools.name: Smithery
tools.connects_to: A public registry of 3,000+ verified MCP servers, installable locally via CLI or hosted remotely
tools.pricing_paid: Paid hosting/compute tiers for remote-run servers
strengths: Largest curated, verified registry
Fast local or remote server deployment
Built-in OAuth handling for authenticated servers
tools.best_for: Discovering and quickly running MCP servers without manual setup

tools.name: Figma MCP
tools.connects_to: Figma design files, frames, and components for design-to-code and design context in agents
strengths: Brings live design context into coding agents
Vendor-backed and actively used by developers
Streamlines design-to-code workflows
tools.best_for: Translating Figma designs into code with AI assistance

tools.name: Supabase MCP
tools.connects_to: Supabase Postgres databases, auth, and backend services for querying and management
strengths: Vendor-maintained database backend access
Covers DB, auth, and storage in one server
Popular developer favorite for app backends
tools.best_for: Giving agents managed access to a Postgres-based app backend

tools.name: Cloudflare MCP
tools.connects_to: Remote MCP servers hosted on Cloudflare Workers with built-in OAuth, routing, and edge deployment
tools.pricing_paid: Workers paid plans for higher usage and compute
strengths: First-class remote MCP hosting on the edge
Built-in OAuth and access controls
Scales server deployment without managing infrastructure
tools.best_for: Deploying and governing remote MCP servers at the edge

tools.name: Stripe MCP
tools.connects_to: Stripe payments, customers, invoices, and billing operations via agent tool calls
tools.pricing_paid: No MCP fee; standard Stripe transaction pricing applies
strengths: Vendor-maintained with least-privilege design
Enables payment and billing automation
Trusted by developers for financial workflows
tools.best_for: Automating payments and billing tasks from AI agents

tools.name: n8n MCP
tools.connects_to: n8n workflow automation—triggering and orchestrating 400+ app integrations as agent tools
tools.pricing_paid: Paid cloud and enterprise tiers for hosted workflows
strengths: Bridges agents to a huge workflow automation catalog
Self-hostable and highly extensible
Turns complex multi-step automations into callable tools
tools.best_for: Exposing automation workflows and app integrations to AI agents

tools.name: Linear MCP
tools.connects_to: Linear issues, projects, and cycles for ticket management and planning context
strengths: Vendor-hosted with sign-in auth
Brings project/ticket context into agents
Frequently cited as a daily developer favorite
tools.best_for: Managing issues and project planning from AI agents

tools.name: Sentry MCP
tools.connects_to: Sentry error tracking, issues, and performance data for debugging context
strengths: Vendor-maintained observability access
Surfaces live error and performance data to agents
Part of the durable production-grade set
tools.best_for: Giving agents real error and performance context for debugging
